usage: The word '體育' is used as a noun referring to sports or physical education.
'體育' can be used to talk about sports activities, PE classes, or sports in general.
It often appears as a subject or object in a sentence discussing sports-related topics.
In everyday spoken Cantonese, '體育' is quite formal but understood widely; in casual speech, people might just say the name of a specific sport.
'體育' can also be part of compound words like '體育館' (sports hall) or '體育課' (PE class).
